title: DeepSeek V4 replaces the old DeepSeek route
summary:
DeepSeek V4 joined the model lineup, image and audio gained finer controls, and usage reports got a calendar instead of three rolling-window buttons.

The `deepseek` model now points to DeepSeek V4 Flash, and `deepseek-pro` adds V4 Pro. Both are paid text models with reasoning and tool support; Flash offers a 1,048,576-token context window. The older V3 and V3.2 aliases were removed.

Image generation gained `fast`, `balanced`, and `pro` reasoning modes, with `balanced` as the default and existing boolean requests still accepted. ElevenLabs speech and music gained an optional seed for best-effort repeatable variants; the audio CLI accepts `--seed` too.

A calendar picker replaces rolling usage buttons with exact UTC days, ISO weeks, and months. Charts and detailed CSV exports follow the selected period, while the account usage API accepts matching `granularity` and `period` parameters. The profile API also again returns tier and next-refill timing for apps displaying quota information.

highlights.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash
highlights.text: Use `deepseek` for V4 Flash, a paid text model with reasoning, tools, and a 1,048,576-token context window. It replaces the previous DeepSeek V3.2 route. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=deepseek).

highlights.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro
highlights.text: Use `deepseek-pro` for V4 Pro, a paid text model with reasoning, tools, and a 65,536-token context window. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=deepseek-pro).

highlights.title: Choose image reasoning
highlights.text: Set image reasoning to `fast`, `balanced`, or `pro`; `balanced` is the default. Existing `reasoning=true` and `reasoning=false` requests still work. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Seed audio variations
highlights.text: Pass a seed to ElevenLabs speech or music generation for distinct, best-effort repeatable variants. GET audio requests use the seed in their cache key, and `polli gen audio` accepts `--seed`. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Pick exact usage periods
highlights.text: Choose a UTC day, ISO week, or month for usage charts and detailed CSV downloads instead of choosing from rolling windows. [Open the dashboard](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).

highlights.title: Query exact usage windows
highlights.text: The account usage API accepts `granularity` and `period` for exact day, week, or month windows; the existing `days` parameter still works. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
